title: schiedea diffusa subsp. macraei
intro: Schiedea diffusa subsp. macraei, commonly known as the Mauna Kea schiedeia, is a rare and endemic flowering plant species found only on the island of Hawaii. It is a member of the Caryophyllaceae family and is known for its unique properties and potential health benefits. The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential therapeutic actions, including wound healing and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Schiedea diffusa subsp. macraei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
